excessCash.rationale: Conditional research assumption: retain 3,000 operating cash (~0.7 month of TTM revenue); add cash+short-term investments 13,685 less buffer. Excludes marketable securities, captive assets and IRS deposit. No claim that all cash is distributable.

otherAssets.rationale: Conditional book-value proxy for equity-method stakes, no market premium. Forecast based on operating EBIT excludes equity-method income; assume no affiliate dividends double counted. Other securities 2,910, insurance investments, IRS deposit and held-for-sale net assets receive no separate addback (deliberate 100% haircut/exclusion, not proven worthless). Strategic operating relationships and disposals remain limitations.

debt.rationale: Conditional book-debt approximation, each current/noncurrent line included once. Do not also subtract disclosed fair-value debt 35,398. Assume material finance-lease claims fall within debt proxy; unallocated financial lease/hedge/held-for-sale financing differences are not independently priced.

leases.rationale: Stale disclosed operating lease balance carried as an estimate, not current fact. Keep operating lease costs within forecast operating margin/FCFF and do not subtract lease liability again. No rent addback. Finance leases covered only by conditional debt approximation; no claim of fully verified lease inventory.

minority.rationale: Book minority interest used as value proxy because forecast is consolidated; no independently observed market value. Not included again in other claims.
